questions.ko: 오늘이 당신의 마지막 날이라면 어떤 하루를 보내고 싶나요?
questions.en: If today was your last day, how would you like to spend it?
What flavor of ice cream do you like?
When do you feel the most for yourself?

questions.ko: 당신이 가장 먼저 떠오르는 노래는 무엇인가요?
questions.en: When you think of a good song, what's the first song that comes to mind?

questions.ko: 나만의 밥도둑!, 난 반찬 '이것'만 있으면 밥 두공기는 넘게 먹을 수 있다.
questions.en: What's your favorite side dish?

questions.ko: 당신에게 가장 감명 깊었던 영화는 무엇인가요?
questions.en: What movie impressed you the most?
What do you do in your spare time?

questions.ko: 당신에게 가장 감명 깊었던 책은 무엇인가요?
questions.en: What book impressed you the most?
What is your favorite music or genre?

questions.ko: 당신이 어떤 사람인지 소개해주세요! 별게아니더라도 좋아요!
questions.en: Introduce who you are! Small things are OK!

questions.ko: 10만원을 가장 알차게 쓸 수 있는 방법은 무엇일까요?
questions.en: What is the best way to spend $100?

questions.ko: 당신에게 혼밥하기 가장 좋은 곳과 그 이유는 무엇인가요?
questions.en: Is there a good place to have a quiet meal alone? What's a good reason?

questions.ko: 당신이 가장 바보 같았던 순간은 언제인가요?
questions.en: When was the most stupid moment for you?
When was the most apologetic moment for your parents?
What are your secrets that others don't know?
What do you most want to achieve?

questions.ko: 늦은 시각, 집에 혼자있는데 누군가 들어오는 인기척이 느껴진다면!?
questions.en: How do you react when you're home alone late at night and you think someone is coming in?

questions.ko: '나'라는 사람에 대해서 다른사람들이 오해하고 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
questions.en: What are other people's misconceptions about me?

questions.ko: 사람과 교류를 하는것에 있어, 자신만의 선은?
questions.en: Are there any standards that you are particularly careful about when interacting with people?

questions.ko: 만약 초능력을 가지게 된다면, 어떤 능력을 가지고 싶나요?
questions.en: If you could have superpowers, what power would you like to have?
What does family mean to you?
What is your favorite vegetable?

questions.ko: 당신은 행복을 위해 얼마만큼의 돈이 필요하다고 생각하시나요?
questions.en: How much money do you think you need to be happy?

questions.ko: 만들어보고싶은 것이 있다면 그건 무엇을 위한것인가요?
questions.en: Is there anything in particular you want to make? What is it for?

questions.ko: 키워보고싶은 동물이 있나요? 그 이유도 말해주세요!
questions.en: Do you have an animal you would like to raise? Please tell me why!

questions.ko: 당신은 미래에, 어떤 모습으로 어떻게 살아가고싶으신가요?
questions.en: Have you ever imagined how you would like to live in the future?

questions.ko: 갑자기 일 년간 여행을 떠나게 된다면, 어디로 떠나고싶으신가요?
questions.en: If you suddenly had to go on a one-year trip, where would you like to go?
How would you describe how you are feeling these days in one line?
List some fun things to do these days!
What color do you think suits you best?

questions.ko: 당신의 감정을 이모티콘으로 나타내자면 어떤 모습인가요?
questions.en: If you express your emotions with emoticons, what form would it take?
What do you care about most about self-care?

questions.ko: 당신이 살면서 가장 힘들었던 적은 언제인가요?
questions.en: When was the most difficult time in your life?

questions.ko: 당신에게 다가왔던 인연에게 가장 미안했던 적은 언제인가요?
questions.en: When was the last time you felt sorry for someone else?

questions.ko: 인생의 방향을 정할 때 가장 중요한 것은 무엇일까요?
questions.en: What is the most important thing when deciding the direction of your life?

questions.ko: 부모님에게 요리를 대접드리게 됐을 때, 당신은 어떤 요리를 하고싶으신가요?
questions.en: If you could cook for your parents, what kind of dish would you like to cook?

questions.ko: 당신이 가장 좋아하는 제철 음식은 무엇인가요?
questions.en: What's your favorite seasonal food?
What makes me happy these days?
What would you do if your friend asked you for an unreasonable request?

questions.ko: 당신을 대할 때, 어떤 점들을 지켜줬으면 좋겠나요?
questions.en: Which behavior do you dislike the most?
Do you like your name?

questions.ko: 당신이 절대 버릴 수 없는 것은 무엇인가요?
questions.en: Is there something you can never throw away?

questions.ko: 당신이 올해 새롭게 깨닫게 된 것에 대해 말씀해주세요
questions.en: Tell us about something new you learned this year.

questions.ko: 괜찮아! 라고 자신있게 말했지만, 하나도 괜찮지 않았던 적은?
questions.en: Have you ever lied about being okay?

questions.ko: 당신의 마음을 편하게 만들어주는 장소는 어디인가요?
questions.en: Where is the place that puts your mind at ease?

questions.ko: 자신이 역사책에 실린다면, 어떤식으로 실리고 싶으시간요?
questions.en: If you were to be featured in a history book, how would you like it to appear?
How would you like to spend the end of the year?

questions.ko: 당신에게 가장 중요하지않은 것은 무엇인가요?(쓰레기 제외!)
questions.en: What is the least important to you? (Except garbage!)

questions.ko: 내일의 당신에게 미션 주기!, 꼭 지켜주세요!!
questions.en: Give a mission to tomorrow's you! ( please keep it!!)
If you could change your gender, what would you like to do first?

questions.ko: 나랑 잘 맞지 않는 사람의 타입은?
questions.en: What type of person is not a good fit for me?
What are you most looking forward to right now?
What's the last time you cried?
What have you been most preoccupied with lately?

questions.ko: 가장 가까운 사람은 나에게 어떤 의미인가요?
questions.en: What does the most precious person mean to you?

questions.ko: 올해 세웠던 목표를 잘 실천하고 있나요?
questions.en: Are you living up to the goals you set this year?
What is your own know-how to focus well?

questions.ko: 힘들 때 위로가 되어 준 음악이 있다면?
questions.en: Is there any music that has comforted you when you are having a hard time?
What trauma is inside me?

questions.ko: 나도 모르게 습관적으로 하는 버릇이 있나요?
questions.en: Do you have a habit you want to change? What have you tried to fix it?
Are you hesitating about anything right now?

questions.ko: 타인에게 들었을 때 가장 기분 좋은 말은?
questions.en: What was the happiest compliment in your life?
What changes do you need in your daily life?
Is there anything you regret a lot?
What does aging mean to me?
Are the me of the past and the me of today very different?
Do you miss someone?
What's the last memory you laughed the most?

questions.ko: 작지만 내게 기쁨을 주는 것이 있다면?
questions.en: It's a small thing, but what makes me happy?
Is there anything you would like to have these days?
Have you been anxious lately?
Do you have friends with whom you share secrets?
What does money mean to me?
What has been the last thing you've been kind to others?
Do you have your favorite song lyrics?
Which color suits me well?
Who do I want to be like?
Do you have any special hobbies of your own?
What music do you listen to the most these days?

questions.ko: 최근 내 마음에 와 닿는 글귀가 있었다면?
questions.en: What if there was a phrase that touched my heart recently?
It's hard, but is there anything you're holding on to?
What does family mean to me?
How do you think people will see you? (What do other people think of me?)
What is a successful life?

questions.ko: 사람들은 잘 모르지만, 알리고 싶은 당신의 장점은?
questions.en: What are my strengths that I want people to know about?
When do you feel you have grown?

questions.ko: 내 인생에 영향을 준 책들이 있다면?
questions.en: Are there any books that have influenced your life?

questions.ko: 실패의 경험이 있나요? 어떤 교훈을 얻었나요?
questions.en: Have you experienced failure? What lessons have you learned?

questions.ko: 하루 중 가장 집중이 잘되는 시간은 언제인가요?
questions.en: What time of day do you have the best concentration?
Is there any food that comes to mind when you think of mom?
If you could set one small goal, what would it be?
3 useful mobile apps?
Who has the longest conversation you had recently?
Is there anyone you would like to get to know?
How are you going to spend your weekend?
Do you have any memories you want to erase?
Have you praised someone recently?
What promises do you often make to me these days?

questions.ko: 오늘 내게 가장 중요한 일은 무엇인가요?
questions.en: What is the most important thing for me today?
